Read APP_AI_MANIFEST.md and repository-wide instructions first.
Run WEBAPP:STATE before writes.
Classify every meaningful component as KEEP / ENHANCE / FIX / INTEGRATE / COMPLETE / REMOVE_WITH_REASON.
Do not create parallel systems. Define data contracts, permissions, failure states, tests and rollback before major implementation.
Work autonomously through safe reversible steps until a verified boundary or real blocker.
Never claim completion without evidence.
